package.description: 面向 AI 短剧与视频创作的三维预演工具。

en-US.description: A 3D previsualization tool for AI short-drama and video production.
en-US.longDescription: DirectorDesk is a 3D previsualization tool for AI short-drama and video production. Block scenes, choreograph actors and camera moves with stand-in models, then export reference videos with companion prompts for video generation models. The built-in AI assistant and MCP agents can edit projects directly.

zh-CN.description: 面向 AI 短剧与视频创作的三维预演工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: 导演台（DirectorDesk）是面向 AI 短剧与视频创作的三维预演工具。用白模搭建场景、安排人物走位与摄影机运镜，预览并导出参考视频与配套提示词，交给视频生成模型。支持内置 AI 助手与 MCP 外部 Agent 直接编辑工程。
zh-CN.name: 导演台
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
修复
- 启动时优先应用语言设置，避免三维加载失败后仍显示中文界面。
- 三维画面无法启动时显示明确提示，支持重试和退出。
Fixes
- Apply the selected or system language before loading the 3D editor.
- Show a localized startup error with Retry and Quit when the 3D view cannot start.
Windows: installer or portable ZIP. Linux: AppImage or tar.gz.
